sentences.text: Të shtunën Ardi shkoi në fshat te gjyshi i tij.
sentences.english: On Saturday Ardi went to the village, to his grandfather.

sentences.text: Ai u nis herët nga Tirana. Gjyshi i dërgoi një mesazh me adresën.
sentences.english: He set out early from Tirana. His grandfather sent him a message with the address.

sentences.text: Ardi kërkoi hartën në celular.
sentences.english: Ardi looked for the map on his phone.

sentences.text: Ardi zbriti nga furgoni në një kryqëzim pas kthesës. Fshati është larg nga qyteti. Ardi shkon atje çdo verë.
sentences.english: Ardi got off the minibus at a crossroads after the bend. The village is far from the city. Ardi goes there every summer.

sentences.text: Gjyshi e priti aty. Ai kishte një kalë të vjetër.
sentences.english: Grandfather waited for him there. He had an old horse.

sentences.text: — Mirë se vjen, Ardi! tha gjyshi. Fshati është afër malit.
sentences.english: "Welcome, Ardi!" said grandfather. "The village is near the mountain."

sentences.text: Gjyshi është bujk. Ai ka një shtëpi të vogël, një oborr dhe shumë tokë.
sentences.english: Grandfather is a farmer. He has a small house, a yard and a lot of land.

sentences.text: Në oborr ka kafshë: lopë, dele dhe një kalë.
sentences.english: In the yard there are animals: cows, sheep and a horse.

sentences.text: Ardi pa lopët dhe delet.
sentences.english: Ardi saw the cows and the sheep.

sentences.text: — Kjo lopë është e sëmurë, tha gjyshi.
sentences.english: "This cow is ill," said grandfather.

sentences.text: — Ajo ka ftohje dhe kollë. Hunda e saj është e kuqe.
sentences.english: "She has a cold and a cough. Her nose is red."

sentences.text: Gjyshi shikoi gojën e saj. Mjeku erdhi dje dhe shkroi një recetë.
sentences.english: Grandfather looked at the cow's mouth. The doctor came yesterday and wrote a prescription.

sentences.text: — Gjumi është ilaç i mirë edhe për kafshët, tha ai.
sentences.english: "Sleep is good medicine for animals too," he said.

sentences.text: Një fshatar erdhi në oborr.
sentences.english: A villager came into the yard.

sentences.text: — Si është ajo? pyeti fshatari.
sentences.english: "How is the cow?" asked the villager.

sentences.text: — Nuk është keq, tha gjyshi. Ajo është e dobët, por nëse pi ujë dhe fle, shërohet ashtu.
sentences.english: "She is not bad," said grandfather. "She is weak, but if she drinks water and sleeps, she gets well that way."

sentences.text: — Nëse ka dhimbje, do të të telefonoj, tha ai.
sentences.english: "If she has pain, I will phone you," he said.

sentences.text: — Nëse nesër bie shi, nuk punojmë, tha gjyshi.
sentences.english: "If it rains tomorrow, we do not work," said grandfather.

sentences.text: Pastaj gjyshi dhe Ardi shkuan në tokë.
sentences.english: Then grandfather and Ardi went to the land.

sentences.text: Dielli ishte i ngrohtë dhe qielli ishte shumë i bukur.
sentences.english: The sun was warm and the sky was very beautiful.

sentences.text: — Në stinën e ngrohtë bujqit mbjellin, tha gjyshi.
sentences.english: "In the warm season farmers sow," said grandfather.

sentences.text: — Në verë ata korrin. Në stinën e ftohtë ka borë dhe toka fle.
sentences.english: "In summer they reap. In the cold season there is snow and the land sleeps."

sentences.text: — Të gjithë fshatarët korrin me makinë, por unë korr me dorë.
sentences.english: "All the villagers reap with a machine, but I reap by hand."

sentences.text: Gjyshi mbolli me dorë. Ardi mbolli edhe ai pak.
sentences.english: Grandfather sowed by hand. Ardi sowed a little too.

sentences.text: Pastaj erdhi një re e zezë dhe një erë e madhe.
sentences.english: Then a black cloud came and a big wind.

sentences.text: — Kjo nuk është stuhi, tha gjyshi. Stuhia është në mal, me borë.
sentences.english: "This is not a storm," said grandfather. "The storm is in the mountains, with snow."

sentences.text: Delet shkuan majtas, kali shkoi djathtas.
sentences.english: The sheep went to the left, the horse went to the right.

sentences.text: Aty ishte një pyll i vogël. Zogjtë këndojnë në pyll.
sentences.english: There was a small forest. Birds sing in the forest.

sentences.text: Një zog i vogël erdhi te Ardi. Ardi dëgjoi zogun dhe buzëqeshi.
sentences.english: A small bird came to Ardi. Ardi listened to the bird and smiled.

sentences.text: Në kodër ka lule të bukura. Ardi gjeti një gur të bardhë.
sentences.english: On the hill there are beautiful flowers. Ardi found a white stone.

sentences.text: — Ky gur është për ty, gjysh, tha ai.
sentences.english: "This stone is for you, grandfather," he said.

sentences.text: Në mesditë ata hëngrën bukë, djathë dhe qumësht.
sentences.english: At midday they ate bread, cheese and milk.

sentences.text: Pasdite Ardi dhe gjyshi pushuan në oborr. Gjyshi është një bujk i mirë dhe i do shumë kafshët e tij.
sentences.english: In the afternoon Ardi and grandfather rested in the yard. Grandfather is a good farmer and loves his animals a lot.

sentences.text: — A të pëlqen fshati? pyeti gjyshi.
sentences.english: "Do you like the village?" asked grandfather.

sentences.text: — Po, më pëlqen shumë. Këtu nuk ka shumë makina dhe shumë njerëz.
sentences.english: "Yes, I like it a lot. Here there are not many cars and many people."

sentences.text: — Në qytet ka shumë gjëra, tha gjyshi, por këtu çdo gjë është afër.
sentences.english: "In the city there are many things," said grandfather, "but here everything is near."

sentences.text: — Do të vish çdo verë?
sentences.english: "Will you come every summer?"

sentences.text: — Do të vij çdo verë, gjysh! tha Ardi.
sentences.english: "I will come every summer, grandfather!" said Ardi.

sentences.text: Ata pritën edhe pak aty. Pastaj gjyshi tha: — Duhet të shkojmë.
sentences.english: They waited there a little longer. Then grandfather said: "We have to go."

sentences.text: Në mbrëmje ata u kthyen në shtëpi.
sentences.english: In the evening they went back to the house.

sentences.text: Gjyshja Drita erdhi nga Tirana dhe e kërkoi Ardin.
sentences.english: Grandmother Drita came from Tirana and looked for Ardi.

sentences.text: — Ja ku jam, gjyshe! tha ai. Sa ditë e bukur!
sentences.english: "Here I am, grandmother!" he said. "What a beautiful day!"
